SELECT octet_length(value::text)<=65536 AS bounded,CASE WHEN octet_length(value::text)<=65536 THEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value)='object' THEN COALESCE(value->'m3u_hash_key','""'::jsonb) ELSE '""'::jsonb END ELSE NULL END AS hash_value FROM core_coresettings WHERE key='stream_settings'

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m3u_m3ufilter WHERE m3u_account_id=$1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelgroupm3uaccount WHERE m3u_account_id=$1 AND auto_channel_sync) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_connect_eventsubscription s JOIN dispatcharr_connect_integration i ON i.id=s.integration_id WHERE s.enabled AND i.enabled AND s.event IN('m3u_refresh','m3u_error')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plugins_pluginconfig WHERE enabled) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id=cs.stream_id WHERE s.m3u_account_id=$1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgrelid IN('m3u_m3uaccount'::regclass,'dispatcharr_channels_channelgroup'::regclass,'dispatcharr_channels_channelgroupm3uaccount'::regclass,'core_systemevent'::regclass))

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM(SELECT id FROM dispatcharr_channels_stream WHERE m3u_account_id=$1 LIMIT 65)s)+(SELECT count(*) FROM(SELECT id FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelgroupm3uaccount WHERE m3u_account_id=$1 LIMIT 17)g)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id=cs.stream_id WHERE s.stream_hash=ANY($1))
